hook.subline: Read this before you hit send.

items.title: Write a clear subject
items.detail: Put your name, course and intake in the subject line. The reader knows the context at once.

items.title: Check the website first
items.detail: If the answer is already on the website or FAQ page, don't ask it by email.

items.title: Keep it short
items.detail: One email, one request. Two or three short paragraphs are enough.

items.title: Use a simple email ID
items.detail: Send it from an ID with your real name. A nickname ID doesn't look serious.

youtube.title: Emailing a university? 4 simple tips
youtube.description:
